snippet.title: 1066 With Knobs On | The People's Count Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
The Bayeux Tapestry. Nearly a thousand years old. Seventy metres long.
For centuries, scholars counted every stitch. Except one thing.

1066 With Knobs On is a light-hearted history game about the most famous embroidery in the world, and the penises nobody talks about. Pan and zoom along the whole tapestry, find every horse, man and mystery member, and mark each one as a penis or a maybe.

Then add your total to The People's Count, a live tally of what players around the world have found. Historians are still arguing about some of these. Now it's your turn to decide.

The stocking filler history forgot to mention.

▶ Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5367020
▶ See everyone's counts: https://polytelygames.com/the-peoples-count

Coming soon to Windows, Mac and Linux.

#ThePeoplesCount #BayeuxTapestry #1066 #IndieGame #History

Made by Polytely Games.
Music: RandomMind (CC0).
